headline: Beverly City Council committee to discuss Budget/Management Analyst applicant interviews and possible executive session.
summary: The committee will announce interview dates for the Budget/Management Analyst position and may go into executive session to discuss applicants for the job.
items: Announcement of interview dates: Monday, October 5, 2026, 9:00-11:00 A.M., and Tuesday, October 6, 2026, 6:00-8:00 P.M.

Proposed Executive Session under Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(8), to consider or interview applicants for employment, if the Chair finds an open meeting would hurt efforts to get qualified applicants.
Announcement by the Chair on whether Open Session will reconvene after Executive Session.
location: Conference Room, Beverly City Hall, 191 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA 01915
